news.title: Bukayo Saka admits World Cup 'scars' remain for England ahead of Nations League
news.lede: The Three Lions look to put the pain of another valiant World Cup semi-final defeat behind them as the Nations League returns. Bukayo Saka seeks to move on from the pain from the summer for England. The Arsenal winger will remember 2026 as the year that he helped his boyhood club claim the Premier League crown for the first time in the Emirates Stadium era. But apart from the regret of losing the Champions League final at the end of May, Three Lions duty also left a lot on the table.

news.title: b4.bet Appoints Former World Cup Winner as Brand Ambassador for Malaysia as the European Club
news.lede: The 2014 World Cup winner and former Real Madrid and Arsenal playmaker will front the platform’s Malaysian sports coverage and its player protection programme. Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia – b4.bet, a digital sports and gaming platform built for the Malaysian market, today announced the appointment of a former World Cup-winning football star as its brand ambassador for Malaysia. The partnership begins as the 2026-27 European club football season gets underway, the period of heaviest football viewership in the Malaysian sporting calendar. He, who retired from professional football in 2023, won the FIFA World Cup with Germany in 2014 and earned more than 90 international caps.

news.title: Everything you need to know about the CAF Strategy Conference: Dates, venue and key issues
news.lede: The Confédération Africaine de Football (CAF) will bring together leading decision-makers, coaches and football experts in Cape Verde in October for a landmark Strategy Conference aimed at shaping the next phase of African football development. The three-day gathering will take place from 7 to 9 October 2026 in Santa Maria, Sal Island, and will be convened under the leadership of CAF President Dr Patrice Motsepe. The Conference comes after Africa’s record participation at the FIFA World Cup 2026, where 10 national teams represented the continent and nine progressed to the knockout stages. Their performances will form an important part of discussions as CAF examines what worked, what can be improved and how African teams can become even more competitive by the FIFA World Cup 2030.

news.title: Lamine Yamal: ‘Football is mechanised but players like me have that special spark’
news.lede: Spain and Barcelona wonderkid has won World Cup and European Championship but says there are no limits for his career. Like the kid he is, Lamine Yamal just wanted to keep playing. This wasn’t Plaça Joan XXIII, wasn’t El Parque de Rocafonda either; it wasn’t the Mataró neighbourhood where it all began, but it might have been. “We’re in a World Cup final and I wanted to carry on,” he says, and there’s the smile again, the braces.

news.title: World Cup and Champions League star Lola Gallardo joins OnlyFans so followers can 'get to know her off the pitch'
news.lede: SPAIN star Lola Gallardo has announced a new partnership with OnlyFans. Gallardo, 33, has joined the platform in a bid to give fans a behind-the-scenes look into her life as a top goalkeeper. The experienced stopper earned 38 Spain caps and was selected for two World Cups by La Roja. She has also won the Champions League with Lyon at club level and now plays for Atletico Madrid.

news.title: FIFA U15 World Cup Requires More Attention, Says Grassroots Sport Forum President Godwin Bamigboye
news.lede: The president of Nigerian Grassroots Sport Development Forum (NGSDF), Godwin Bamigboye has charged the country’s decision makers in football to give better attention to preparations for the forthcoming FIFA U-15 World Cup. Sports247 reports that, with the cadet championship and festival scheduled to hold in Azerbaijan from the 24th to 30th of next month, Bamigboye is worried that Nigeria has not set preparations in motion; and warned that such levity could adversely affect the country’s team. Bamigboye went on to urge top shots at Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) and National Sports Commission (NSC) to immediately commence full fledged action, in order to ensure the country’s team, Baby Eagles, get a good outing in the championship.
